statements.quote: AI Cloud Services revenue increased ~8x to $128.8m in FY26 (vs FY25 $16.4m)
statements.notes: Seller-side AI revenue (AI Cloud Services segment). The FY25 comparative of $16.4m precedes the reported year and is not recorded. The $4bn contracted ARR and $1bn operating ARR are annualized run-rate operating metrics. The release says they are not GAAP revenue, so they are not recorded as fiscal-year revenue outlooks.

statements.quote: Adjusted EBITDA decreased in Q4 FY26 reflecting increased employee related costs and broader platform investment ahead of AI Cloud Services revenue ramp
statements.notes: Links higher Q4 FY26 employee costs and platform investment to the AI Cloud ramp, in words only. The scope is ambiguous because the costs are company-wide but are attributed to the AI build-out.

none_found.reason: No sentence states an amount of capital expenditures or AI's share of them. The 90%, 96% and 45-55% figures are financing and prepayment coverage ratios of GPU capex, not capex amounts or AI shares.
